Questions

Good to know

Anything not covered here, just ask — we'd rather you had the answer up front.

What kind of projects do you take on?

Small and medium-scale work across building and renovation — kitchens and bathrooms, home and office renovation, general building and maintenance, carpentry and joinery, all aspects of roofing, landscaping and flooring. If you're not sure whether your job fits, call and ask.

How do I get a price?

Contact us for a free consultation. Charlie will come and look at the job, talk through what you need, and come back with a clear written price and timescale before any work starts.

Who actually carries out the work?

Experienced teams working under professional supervision, following safety and construction standards throughout the job. Charlie stays across the job from start to finish.

How soon can you start?

It depends on the size of the job and what's already booked in. Get in touch and we'll give you an honest answer on timings rather than a hopeful one.

Do you handle the mess and clearing up?

Yes. Sites are kept tidy as work goes on and cleared properly at the end — you shouldn't be left with a skip's worth of someone else's rubbish.

Do you guarantee your work?

Yes — a five-year guarantee on our workmanship. If something we've done isn't right, we come back and put it right.

Which areas do you cover?

We're based in Surrey and cover the whole county, plus anywhere within roughly ten miles of it. If you're not sure whether your address falls inside that, call and ask — it's a short conversation.

Privacy policy

Last updated: September 2026

Who we are

CD Building Solutions (“we”, “us”, “our”) is owned and run by Charlie Dixon. We are the data controller for the information described below. You can contact us about anything on this page on 07561 106306 or at cdbuildingsolutions1@gmail.com.

What we collect

Only what you choose to give us when you get in touch: your name, phone number, email address, the service you're asking about and whatever you tell us about the job and the property. If you call or email us directly, we hold whatever is in that call or message. Our hosting provider may also keep standard server logs, which can include IP addresses, for security and to keep the site running.

Why we use it, and our lawful basis

We use your details to reply to you, arrange a free consultation, quote for the work and, if you go ahead, carry it out and keep records of it. Our lawful basis is that the processing is necessary to take steps at your request before entering into a contract, and to perform that contract if one follows. Where no contract follows, we rely on our legitimate interest in responding to people who contact us. We do not use your details for marketing, and we do not sell or rent them to anyone.

Who else sees it

Enquiries sent through the form on this site are delivered to our email inbox by a third-party form-delivery service acting on our instructions, and are then held by our email provider. Both act as processors for us. We may share your details with a tradesperson or supplier where that is necessary to carry out your job, and with our accountant or professional advisers where we have to. We will also disclose information where the law requires it. Some of these providers may process data outside the UK; where that happens it is covered by the safeguards those providers have in place.

How long we keep it

Enquiries that don't lead to work are kept only as long as we reasonably need them, and then deleted. Where we carry out work for you, we keep the job and financial records for six years from the end of the relevant tax year, as tax law requires.

Keeping it safe

We take reasonable steps to keep your information secure, including access-controlled accounts and encrypted connections. No transmission over the internet can be guaranteed completely secure, so anything you send us is sent at your own risk.

Your rights

Under UK data protection law you have the right to ask us for a copy of the information we hold about you, to have it corrected if it's wrong, to have it deleted, to restrict or object to how we use it, and in some cases to have it transferred to someone else. Where we rely on your consent, you can withdraw it at any time. Email us and we'll deal with it within one month.

Complaints

If you're unhappy with how we've handled your information, please tell us first so we can put it right. You also have the right to complain to the Information Commissioner's Office at ico.org.uk, or on 0303 123 1113.

Children

This website is aimed at people arranging building work and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect information about anyone under 18.

Changes

If we change this policy we'll update the date at the top of it. Please check back from time to time.

Subject to that, we are not liable for any loss or damage arising from your use of, or inability to use, this website, or from reliance on anything on it. The site is provided “as is”.

Cookies

Last updated: September 2026

The short version

This website does not use cookies to track you. There is no analytics, no advertising network, no social media tracking pixel and no profiling of visitors. That's why you aren't seeing a cookie banner — there is nothing to consent to.

What that means in practice

We don't set any cookies of our own, and we don't know who you are unless you choose to tell us by calling, emailing, or sending the enquiry form.

Third parties

If you submit the enquiry form, the third-party service that delivers it to our inbox processes that submission on our behalf and may use strictly necessary technical cookies to do so. Our hosting provider keeps standard server logs for security. If you click through to our Instagram profile, Instagram's own cookies and privacy terms apply once you're on their site — not ours.

Controlling cookies

You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings at any time. Doing so will not affect how this website works.
